To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the case based teaching method of genetics was a pedagogical innovation that was developed by geneticists in the 1925 1950 period, and that this method of teaching was used by geneticists in their textbooks to create a space for students to develop an understanding of the rules of genetics through simulations.
the history of genetics is used as a tool for teaching and learning genetics.
geneticists created an historical method of teaching genetics that was used to teach students how to go on in their practice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of historical exemplars in the development of a scientific discipline.
the ways in which the historical environment of a scientific discipline can be seen to be constitutive of the practice of its members.
how the historical environment of a textbook, as a form of scientific representation, is a means of teaching the tacit, experiential, and historical aspects of science.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper shows how geneticists used history to create a space for their students to learn how to do genetics.
the history of science is used in science in a variety of ways and for various purposes, but the history of genetics is used in genetics to teach students how to be geneticists.
the history of science was used in textbooks to teach genetics as a discipline and as a way of life.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
history is a tool for science.
history is a powerful resource for science, and that it can be put to use in many ways.
history is not just an object of study in the sciences.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the history of science can be used to teach science.
history can be more than a source of examples, and that it can also be a tool to teach students how to think and act like scientists.
the uses of history are not only important for the construction of the past, but also for the reproduction of scientific disciplines and their practitioners in the present.
